api.run: MemoryToolRun(state: MemoryState, utterances: [String]) captures immutable snapshot and utterances plus public baseRevision.
api.search: mutating search(argumentsJSON: String) throws -> MemoryToolSearchResult; resultJSON() emits ok/memories[id,kind,content]. Only this method sets latest candidate IDs, replacing even with an empty result.
api.prepare: prepare(toolName: String, argumentsJSON: String) throws -> MemoryToolReview; no mutation, network or disk writes.
api.apply: MemoryToolReview.apply(to: inout MemoryState, conversationID: String? = nil, now: Date) throws -> MemoryToolReceipt
api.receipt: Host-only MemoryNote includes existing RAM undo token/pendingID. resultJSON/Encodable exclude note and emit pinned success fields. Host must persist the complete candidate snapshot before publication or reporting success.

limits.reason: Upstream optional nullable string has no reason-specific length or nonblank limit. Accepted as metadata only; never grounding or authority. Host must bound raw model response bytes.
limits.arguments: Strict tool-specific keys/types; duplicate decoded keys including escaped equivalents, unknown fields, wrong types, malformed/trailing JSON and required nulls are rejected. Original raw argument bytes must be preserved.

preserved: Current quote membership uses case-sensitive NFKC substring comparison and at least two UTF16 units. Specific values use quote plus all current utterances.

Edit requires explicit operation intent in quote, no corresponding negation in any FULL matching current message, a latest-search candidate, and exact quoted ID boundaries when multiple candidates exist.
Save/update use user_said provenance. Explicit tools require useMemory but work with autoRemember off. Procedure writes/updates remain pending until separately approved.
Omitted update keywords preserve existing words; explicit [] clears them. Delete yields forgot note; undo is RAM-only, bounded to fifty, and absent after Codable relaunch.

deltas.name: Required iOS proposal review
deltas.detail: Pinned tools apply directly after validation. iOS prepares immutable review, binds state revision, requires host approval and atomic persistence before publishing. Parsing alone grants no write authority.

deltas.name: Current-only first version
deltas.detail: Pinned memory_save accepts one narrowly host-registered previous confirmation. This API intentionally does not expose that exception; only current-run user utterances are accepted.

deltas.name: Traditional Chinese localization
deltas.detail: Adds 刪除/刪掉/刪了/忘記/別記/不要記/取消記憶/改為/編輯 and corresponding 別/無需/無須 and other negations to Mika literal patterns. Full-message negations additionally cover cancelling memory and negated do-not-remember phrases. Sixty-two assertions exercise positive and negative cases including clipped-quote bypass.

deltas.name: Inherited iOS state protections
deltas.detail: Existing duplicate-content rejection and late-undo protection remain. Reviews additionally reject stale/replayed state, and JSON parser rejects raw duplicate keys.

hostContract: Capture snapshot after context markUsed. Validate live generation, master switch, availability and revision before every search/prepare and again at commit.

Host supplies only current actual user words; website, tool, assistant, old-turn and saved-memory text cannot be inferred to be utterances. The String array cannot independently authenticate provenance.

Host owns one search, one mutation across profile/memory, three foreground structured model calls including format correction/final, and a ninety-second deadline including review. Core deliberately still replaces latest-search candidates on each search.
Apply to a disposable value, atomically persist full encrypted snapshot preserving all other fields, then publish state/note/receipt. Core success alone proves no disk write.
Any separate automatic extraction is outside the foreground three-call budget and must retain/supersede explicit-operation notes correctly; not exercised by this core evidence.
heuristicLimits: Specifics detect quoted strings, normalized ASCII digit runs, Latin identifiers of at least three characters and pinned Simplified Chinese Han place suffixes. Unquoted Chinese names/places without matching suffixes can escape detection.
Number normalization is matching normalization, not numeric interpretation. No grammar allowlist or semantic entailment proof is introduced.
Literal intent/negation and sensitive-data detection are bounded heuristics, not proof of consent or complete secret detection. Explicit host review remains required.
